metadata_scope: Public summary of the approved image set; private selection paths and device records are excluded.

runtime_approval.evidence: Recorded normal Android gameplay and offline save/restart checks were accepted with the limitations in docs/NATIVE_QA.json. This is dated local verification; production, physical-device, audible-audio and interactive-browser acceptance is not claimed.
